Guidelines: IR when initiating     -    lowest effective dose

Admin: dosing =use/goals, prev opioid use, co-meds, pt factors (renal fun, old)
allergy: cross-rxn ->  diff opioid chem class    -   Miosis    -   pruritus (his release)
Euphoria: abuse potential -w.draw on abrupt cessation
resp depress (↓CO2 sensitivity): MCC of death in acute OD
constipation (OIC): prevent: stimt laxative ± stool softener, PEG
refractory → PAMORAs (periph-act μ-r antagonists) → reverse constipation w.o affecting analgesia: methylnaltrexone, naloxegol, naldemedine
↑risk: renal insuff, dehydrate, old, concurr benzo/TCA

tx: switch to dissimilar opioid, hydration, Sx/S control
